notes.zh-CN: 修复 dsh-acp（DeepSeek Harness）上报新模型 ID 形态（DeepSeek-V41-Flash / ["deepseek-official","deepseek-flash"]）时，支持视觉的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 被误报为不支持图片输入的问题。本次仅提供 macOS universal 安装包；Windows x64/ARM64 因 GitHub Actions 账户付款限制未能构建。
notes.en: Fixed DeepSeek V4.1 Flash being wrongly reported as text-only when dsh-acp (DeepSeek Harness) reports its new model id forms (DeepSeek-V41-Flash / ["deepseek-official","deepseek-flash"]). This release ships the macOS universal build only; the Windows x64/ARM64 installers could not be built because GitHub Actions jobs are blocked by the account payment limit.
